A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VecFormer research work. All 19 pages in each version, including equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original VecFormer evaluations on FloorPlanCAD, controlled ablations in Table 2, and sequence-length and qualitative analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the original FloorPlanCAD results, controlled ablations, and appendix analyses reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same line sampling, PTv3 backbone, line pooling, layer feature enhancement, dual-branch decoder, losses, and Branch Fusion Refinement procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate panoptic symbol spotting and primitive-level semantic prediction on FloorPlanCAD. Coverage with and without layer priors and the appendix test examples remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1a retains PanCADNet, CADTransformer, GAT-CADNet, SymPoint, SymPoint-V2, CADSpotting, and DPSS in the same comparison settings. Table 1b retains GAT-CADNet, SymPoint, and SymPoint-V2.

E3.justification: The 6,965/810/3,827 training/validation/test split, PQ and semantic metrics, 500-epoch training schedule, augmentations, and prior-information settings remain unchanged. The sampling configurations in the ablations and Appendix C also match.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains the same sampling-strategy, sampling-ratio, BFR, and prior-information ablations. Appendices A–D retain the same representation comparisons, sampling-density visualizations, sequence-length analysis, and qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All reported results match, including Tables 1–2 and Figure 6. Both versions report VecFormer PQ of 91.1 with priors and 88.4 without priors, F1 of 93.8, and weighted F1 of 92.2. Qualitative outputs are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 retain the same sampling, feature construction, pooling, loss, refinement, and evaluation definitions. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about expressive type-agnostic line representations, BFR, and state-of-the-art FloorPlanCAD performance. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the interpretations concerning geometric continuity, sequence efficiency, and robustness without priors. Section 5 preserves the limitation of uniform sampling in geometrically complex regions and the proposed future direction of adaptive sampling.

D1.justification: v3 adds a first-page code-availability statement identifying the VecFormer GitHub repository. This access information is absent from v2's text. Section 4.2 retains the same implementation details; the PDFs do not establish repository contents or functionality.

R1.justification: The same 40 cited works and the same related-work discussion are retained. No prior work is added or removed, and VecFormer's positioning relative to point-based, graph-based, and raster approaches is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 updates affiliation numbering/order and the corresponding-author email, replaces the preprint notice with a NeurIPS 2025 notice, and adds the code statement and a brief funding acknowledgement. The research prose and substantive section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The code statement and acknowledgements cause limited text and reference reflow. All ten figures and both tables retain their content and organization. The rendered appendix pages are visually identical between versions.

improvement.justification: The new repository reference modestly improves implementation discoverability and reproducibility documentation, while the acknowledgement adds funding transparency. The scientific content and appendix evidence remain unchanged, so the gain is limited. The PDFs alone cannot verify the repository's availability or completeness.
